title: Medemer Artificial Intelligence University
summary:
Medemer Artificial Intelligence University is a planned institution in Ethiopia designed to train specialists in artificial intelligence and advanced digital technologies. The university was approved by Ethiopia's Council of Ministers and announced by Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed at the 39th African Union Summit in February 2026.

The university is named after the Ethiopian philosophy of Medemer, meaning synergy or purposeful collaboration. Prime Minister Abiy stated that the institution will unite human values with machine intelligence, local context with global relevance, and scientific rigor with applied impact. It will operate as an autonomous institution focused on training researchers and specialists in artificial intelligence.

Ethiopia established Africa's first Artificial Intelligence Institute in 2020, and the Medemer AI University builds on this foundation. The planned university aims to attract students from across Africa and is set to launch within one year of announcement. The institution merges Ethiopian philosophical principles with international AI standards, fostering local innovation while contributing to Africa-wide technological leadership.

The establishment of the university was approved alongside three major external loan agreements and a new national tourism policy during the Council of Ministers' 53rd regular meeting. Ethiopia positions the university as part of its broader ambitions for digital transformation and AI leadership on the African continent.
